Intel (INTC) annual revenue fell 33.1% in 4 years ($79.0B → $52.9B). The numbers show the size of the change, not its cause.

Latest fiscal year: FY2025 (ended Dec 27, 2025)
• Revenue: $52.9B (−0.5% YoY)
• Operating margin: −4.2%
• Net margin: −0.5%
• Free cash flow: −$4.9B (−9.4% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Sep 26, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $16.5B (+20.9% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 15.3%

4-year view (FY2021 → FY2025)
• Revenue: $79.0B → $52.9B (compound annual growth −9.6%)
• Operating margin: 24.6% → −4.2% (−28.8 pts)
• Free cash flow: $10.7B → −$4.9B
• Year that stands out: FY2024, operating margin −22.0%, revenue growth −2.1%
